title: Shrikhand
description: A thick, creamy strained-curd dessert from Maharashtra and Gujarat, sweetened and scented with saffron and cardamom.

ingredients.name: Curd
ingredients.notes: hung in muslin in the fridge for 5 hours, to yield about 400 g thick curd

steps: Tie the curd in a clean muslin cloth and hang it for about 5 hours, until all the whey drains and a thick, firm mass remains.
Warm the milk and steep the saffron in it for 10 minutes.
Transfer the hung curd to a bowl and add the powdered sugar and saffron milk.
Whisk or fold for 2 to 3 minutes until completely smooth and glossy.
Stir in the cardamom powder and chill for at least 1 hour.
Serve topped with the sliced pistachios.
